name: pickup_spawn_list_clear
description: Removes every spawn node from a pickup spawn list and resets the global next-pickup id when clearing the primary list.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent pickup.cpp source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41e240 validates iteration through list head, RemoveAndFreeNode calls, and the primary-list g_NextPickupId reset. The native pickup spawn-list smoke validates primary and network list clear behavior.
